beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt:
Never block this prompt (always ok: true).

Inspect the user prompt in $ARGUMENTS.

Fire YES only if either is true:
(1) Spanish text the agent must translate to act correctly, or
(2) English that could reasonably be understood two different ways and that ambiguity would change the task.

If YES: ok true, reason exactly: APPLY_SKILL sense-rewrite — rewrite corrected native American English in > quotes, then a --- line, then continue the answer.

If NO (clear English, or typos that do not change meaning): ok true, reason empty.

Do not treat kdx-triage invocations as YES when that skill will restate English itself.
